# Home News API v1

## Purpose

Tomos exposes a small structured News collection to a theme's home template. The core selects public pages and supplies data; the theme owns all HTML and CSS.

This is a general Tomos theme API. It is not specific to research-lab sites.

## Source

The source path comes from root-level `theme-settings.php`:

```php
'news' => [
    'enabled' => true,
    'path' => '/news/',
    'limit' => 5,
    'heading' => 'NEWS',
    'more_label' => 'View all',
],
```

`path` is configurable. `/news/` is only the default.

## Template variables

The home context contains:

- `home.has_news`
- `home.news_items`
- `home.news_url`

Each item in `home.news_items` contains:

- `date`
- `date_display`
- `title`
- `url`

`date` and `date_display` are currently normalized to `YYYY-MM-DD`. Themes may choose how to present them with HTML/CSS, but Tomos does not generate News HTML.

Example:

```html
{{# home.has_news }}
<section class="home-news">
  <h2>{{ theme.news_heading }}</h2>
  <div class="news-list">
    {{# home.news_items }}
    <article class="news-item">
      <time datetime="{{ date }}">{{ date_display }}</time>
      <h3><a href="{{ url }}">{{ title }}</a></h3>
    </article>
    {{/ home.news_items }}
  </div>
  <a href="{{ home.news_url }}">{{ theme.news_more_label }}</a>
</section>
{{/ home.has_news }}
```

## Selection rules

Tomos:

1. uses the metadata index rather than re-parsing Markdown bodies for the home collection;
2. ignores draft entries;
3. selects descendants of the configured source path;
4. excludes the source list/index page itself;
5. reuses `PageSorter`, so News ordering is the same standard article ordering used elsewhere;
6. applies the configured limit, clamped by ThemeSettings to 1-10;
7. returns `home.has_news = false` when disabled or when no matching pages exist.

## URL rules

`home.news_url` and each item `url` respect Tomos `public_base_path`.

The normal template URL sanitizer applies to `home.news_url` and item `url`.

## Backward compatibility

Existing themes do not need to change. The new context has no output unless a template explicitly references `home.*`.

No bundled standard theme is changed in Phase 3.

## Metadata-cache boundary

The normal Tomos configuration keeps `features.metadata_cache` enabled. The home News context reads the already-built `cache/index/pages.json` and does not scan or re-parse content files during template rendering.

If metadata caching is explicitly disabled, the structured home News context intentionally returns no items rather than performing a second full content scan during rendering. This keeps the Phase 3 performance contract explicit. A future change may pass the in-memory page collection directly into the renderer if Tomos needs first-class support for this uncommon configuration.

## Non-scope

Phase 3 does not add:

- News HTML generated by core;
- category filtering;
- thumbnails;
- excerpts;
- a News editor;
- official-site theme changes;
- research-lab-specific behavior.
